program.name: Yoga Flow 35
program.subject: Yoga flow
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of joint-by-joint yoga: lower body, or upper body.
program.about: Joint-by-joint yoga for about half an hour. One day the ankles, knees and hips, the other the spine, shoulders and wrists, each moved through circles and then into poses. They alternate and close with a rest. Level II holds every pose longer and Level III brings harder poses.
